title: A map people and agents can read
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: a map that's used goes stale, so it moves from slides to text, each element written once with a stable ID, an owner and its evidence; every change reviewed and versioned; every view generated from it; and agents that read it, draft changes and never confirm one.
howto: Paper on a wall is a draft; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model; lines of text are the map kept as files. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side, and a gold tick is an owner's confirmation. The small glass figure with a ring is the map's agent.
